issue.title: Remove stale Symvision epic-symbol exemptions for closed bead sase-n9
issue.description: During glossary_sase_monitor verification on 2026-08-16, after just install completed, just check passed fmt (python), fmt (markdown), keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, feature-flag schema, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed at lint (symvision). Symvision rejects three Justfile --epic-symbol entries because bead sase-n9 is closed: sase-n9(agent_family_plan_preview_detail), sase-n9(agent_family_plan_preview_documentation), and sase-n9(family_plan_preview_cache_key). Reproduction command: just check. Impact: every agent whose tree reaches this gate is blocked by a stale whitelist unrelated to their diff. Scope: remove or retarget the stale Justfile exemptions and clean up the underlying symbols according to the Symvision epic-whitelist policy; do not treat this as part of the glossary memory change.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-kc — same stale Symvision --epic-symbol exemption pattern for a closed bead, but for sase-js symbols; closed after the specific Justfile entries and underlying symbols were cleaned up.
RELATED: sase-jg — same stale Symvision --epic-symbol exemption pattern for a closed bead, but for sase-j3(SnippetTriggerMatch); useful precedent, not a duplicate of the current sase-n9 symbols.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced while running just check for an unrelated change (restoring Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only, plan restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md). Same three stale --epic-symbol entries for closed bead sase-n9 block the symvision lint gate on current master.
